claim: Robinhood's 2015 Golden Kitty trophy is now a token on Robinhood's own chain, and unlike almost every meme coin it is priced in gold: gold sits on the other side of every trade.
why_this_claim: It is the longform's own locked thesis (hook line and closing line are a deliberate bookend), it needs no market-cap, chart, chain-volume or stonk-narrative context to land, and every word chosen is already airable under the project's hard constraints (never 'backed by', never 'treasury', never 'floor'). The trophy history, the token stats, the Robinhood Chain numbers and the stonk narrative are each a second idea; the short proves ONE thing, the gold pairing, with the hook asserting it, the C1 pool diagram showing the mechanism, and the vibe-cut face line sealing it.
